thong tin de nghi nhung khong qua 12 thang tinh tir ngay Tong cuc Thue hoac
Cuc Thue gui van ban thong bao két qua dang ky moi hoac bo sung thoi han sir
dung cho dau moi dang ky cua ben sir dung thong tin."
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luai

32. Sura doi, bo sung khoan 1, khoan 3 Dieu 50 nhu sau:
“1. Tong cuc Thue, Cuc Thue thuc hien viec thu hoi tai khoan truy cap
Cong thong tin dien tir trong cac trurong hop sau:
a) Khi co de nghi tu dau moi dang ky cia ben sur dung thong tin;
b) Thoi han sur dung da hét;
c) Tai khoan truy cap Cong thong tin dien tur khong thuc hien viec tra curu
thong tin trong thoi gian 06 thang lien tuc;
d) Phat hien trurong hop su dung thong tin hoa don dien tiu khong dung
muc dich, phuc vu cho hoat dong nghiep vu theo chuc nang, nhiem vu cia ben
sir dung thong tin, khong dung quy dinh cua phap luat ve bao ve bi mat nha
nuoc."
“3. Cham nhat la 05 ngay lam viec truoc thoi diem chinh thurc cham dut
dung thong tin (trur truong hop dau moi dang ky cia ben si dung thong tin co
de nghi bang van ban), Tong cuc Thue, Cuc Thue thong bao bang hinh thitc
dien tir cho ben sir dung thong tin ve viec cham dit sir dung cac hinh thurc cung
cap, str dung thong tin hoa don dien tu, churng tiu dien tir."
33. Sua doi, bo sung khoan 5 Dieu 52 nhu sau:
“"5. Truong hop tam ngirng cung cap thong tin hoa don dien t, Tong cuc
Thue thuc hien thong bao tren Cong thong tin dien tir cua Tong cuc Thué ve
hoa don dien tir voi cac ben st dung thong tin. Noi dung thong bao phai neu ro
khoang thoi gian du kien phuc hoi cac hoat dong cung cap thong tin."
34. Sura doi, bo sung khoan 1 va khoan 4 Dieu 53 nhu sau:
“1. Si dung thong tin hoa don dien tur dung muc dich, phuc vu cho hoat
dong nghiep vu theo churc nang, nhiem vu cia ben sir dung thong tin, dung quy
dinh cua phap luat ve bao ve bi mat nha nuoc. Cac thong tin thu thap tir co quan
thue, ben str dung thong tin khong cung cap thong tin cho ben thur ba khi chua
co su dong y cia co quan thue cung cap thong tin hoac tai khoan."
“4. Quan ly, bao mat thong tin tai khoan truy cap Cong thong tin dien tur."
35. Sura doi, bo sung Dieu 54 nhu sau:
“Dieu 54. Kinh phi thuc hien
Kinh phi thuc hien viec tra curu, cung cap, sur dung thong tin hoa don dien
tur ngan sach nha nuoc tren co so du toan kinh phi hang nam duroc phe duyet
cho cac co quan, don vi theo quy dinh cia phap luat."
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luat

36. Sura doi ten Dieu 56 va sura doi, bo sung Dieu 56 nhu sau:
“Dieu 56. Quyen va trach nhiem cia nguroi mua hang hoa, dich vu
1. Nguoi mua hang hoa, dich vu co quyen:
a) Yeu cau nguoi ban lap va giao hoa don khi mua hang hoa, dich vu.
b) Cung cap chinh xac thong tin can thiet de nguoi ban lap hoa don.
c) Ky cac lien hoa don da ghi day du noi dung trong truong hop cac ben
co thoa thuan ve viec nguoi muakytren hoa don.
d) Tra curu, nhan file goc hoa don dien tur cua nguoi ban.
kinh doanh; de chung minh quyen sur dung, quyen so htru hang hoa, dich vu;
xo so hoac dugc boi thuong thiet hai theo quy dinh cua phap luat; dugc dung
de hach toan ke toan hoat dong mua hang hoa, dich vu theo quy dinh cua phap
luat ve ke toan; ke khai cac loai thué; dang ky quyen sir dung, quyen so htru va
de ke khai thanh toan von ngan sach nha nuoc theo cac quy dinh cua phap luat.
Hoa don dung cho muc dich nay phai la hoa don co thong tin xac dinh duoc
nguoi mua.
2. Nguoi mua hang hoa, dich vu co trach nhiem:
a) Siu dung hoa don dung muc dich.
b) Cung cap thong tin tren hoa don cho cac co quan co tham quyen khi
dugc yeu cau, truong hop sir dung hoa don do co quan thue dat in thi phai cung
cap hoa don ban goc, truong hop sir dung hoa don dien tir thi thuc hien quy
dinh ve viec tra ctru, cung cap, sur dung thong tin hoa don dien ti."
37. Bo sung Dieu 57a vao sau Dieu 57 nhu sau:
“Dieu 57a. Trach nhiem cia co quan hai quan trong quan ly chirng
tir dien tir
1. Tong cuc Hai quan co trach nhiem:
a) Xay dung co so du lieu ve chung tur dien tur de phuc vu cong tac quan
ly thue, phuc vu cong tac quan ly nha nuroc cia cac co quan khac cua nha nuoc;
b) Thong bao cac loai chung tu da duoc phat hanh, duoc bao mat, khong
con gia tri str dung.
2. Cuc Hai quan co trach nhiem:
a) Quan ly hoat dong tao, phat hanh churng tur cua cac to chuc da dang ky
tao, phat hanh chung tur voi co quan hai quan tren dja ban quan ly;
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luat

b) Thanh tra, kiem tra hoat dong tao, phat hanh va sir dung chung tur tren
dia ban;
c) Theo doi, kiem tra hoat dong huy chung tur theo quy dinh cia Bo Tai
chinh tren dja ban."
38. Sura doi, bo sung khoan 3 Dieu 58 nhu sau:
“3. To churc, ca nhan san xuat, nhap khau nhung san pham chiu thué tieu
quet ma QR cho san pham san xuat tai Viet Nam truoc khi tieu thu trong nuoc
hoac san pham san xuat o nuoc ngoai khi nhap khau de dam bao ket noi thong
tin ve in va sur dung tem, tem dien tut gitra to churc san xuat, nhap khau voi co
quan quan ly thue. Thong tin ve in, sir dung tem dien tir la co so de lap, quan
ly va xay dung co so dur lieu hoa don dien tir. Cac doi turong su dung tem co
Tai chinh."
39. Bo sung khoan 2a vao sau khoan 2 Dieu 60 nhu sau:
“2a. Truong hop to chtrc, ho kinh doanh, ca nhan kinh doanh thuoc dien
ap dung hoa don dien tu khoi tao tur may tinh tien theo quy dinh tai Nghi dinh
nay nhung chua co may tinh tien do chua dap ing dieu kien ve ha tang cong
nghe thong tin, giai phap xuat hoa don dien tur tir may tinh tien thi co quan thue
co ke hoach, giai phap ho trg va thong bao den nguroi nop thue ve viec chuyen
doi ap dung hoa don dien tur khoi tao tur may tinh tien. Trurong hop nguoi nop
thué da durgc co quan thue ho trg va thong bao ve viec chuyen doi ap dung hoa
don dien tir khoi tao tur may tinh tien nhung khong chuyen doi thi dugc xac
dinh la hanh vi vi pham quy dinh ve sir dung hoa don, co quan thue phoi hop
voi co quan co tham quyen de xiur ly vi pham theo quy dinh cua phap luat."
40. Stra doi, bo sung Dieu 61 nhu sau:
"Dieu 61. Trach nhiem thi hanh
1. Cac Bo truong, Thi truong co quan ngang bo, Thi truong co quan
thuoc Chinh phi, can cur churc nang, nhiem vu duoc giao co trach nhiem trien
khai thuc hien Nghi dinh nay.
2. Bo Tai chinh co trach nhiem hurong dan, to churc trien khai giai phap
hoa don dien tr khoi tao tiur may tinh tien, hoa don dien tir doi voi hoat dong
thuong mai dien tir.
3. Bo Cong Thuong co trach nhiem trien khai cac giai phap de quan ly
toan bo hoat dong kinh doanh thurong mai dien tur va phoi hop voi Bo Tai chinh
trien khai cac giai phap hoa don dien tur doi voi hoat dong thuong mai dien tur
theo quy dinh tai Nghi dinh nay.
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luat

4. Uy ban nhan dan cac tinh, thanh pho truc thuoc trung uong chi dao cac
co quan, don vi tren dia ban phoi hop de trien khai thuc hien Nghi dinh nay
Uy ban nhan dan cac tinh, thanh pho trurc thuoc trung uong co trach nhiem chi
dao Uy ban nhan dan cac cap co trach nhiem phoi hop voi co quan thué dé ra
soat, phan loai va co giai phap thuc day nguroi nop thue chuyen doi ap dung hoa
don dien tu khoi tao tur may tinh tien. Truong hop nguoi nop thue thuoc dien
trien khai hoa don dien tur khoi tao tu may tinh tien nhung chua thuc hien
chuyen doi do chua dap urng dieu kien ve ha tang cong nghe thong tin thi co
quan thue bao cao Uy ban nhan dan de co giai phap ho tro kip thoi ve ha tang
cong nghe thong tin; truong hop nguoi nop thue thuoc dien trien khai hoa don
dien tur khoi tao tu may tinh tien nhung khong thuc hien chuyen doi thi co quan
thué bao cao Uy ban nhan dan de chi dao cac co quan ban nganh dia phuong
phoi hop de xiu ly vi pham ve hanh vi khong xuat hoa don khi ban hang hoa,
dich vu theo quy dinh, xir ly ve dang ky kinh doanh do vi pham phap luat thue
va hoa don. Co quan thue tham muu Uy ban nhan dan phoi hop voi Hoi bao ve
nguoi tieu dung Viet Nam de phat dong va trien khai cac phong trao nguoi tieu
dung van minh thuc hien lay hoa don khi mua hang hoa, dich vu nham lan toa
chi truong chinh sach cua Nha nuoc."
Dieu 2. Sira doi, bo sung mot so mau tai Phy luc ban hanh kem
theo Nghi dinh so 123/2020/ND-CP, bai bo mot so quy dinh cia Nghi
dinh so 123/2020/ND-CP
1. Bo sung Mau so 01/BK-DCTT, Mau so 01/TH-DT, Mau so 04/SS-CTDT
vao Phu luc IA; bo sung Mau so 01/TB-NSD vao Phu luc IB ban hanh kem
theo Nghi dinh nay.
2. Sua doi, bo sung Mau so 01/DKTD-HDDT, Mau so 04/SS-HDDT, Mau
so 06/DN-PSDT, Mau so 01/TH-HDDT, Mau so BC26/BLDT, Mau so
01/DKTD-CTDT tai Phu luc IA, Mau so 01/TB-TNDT, Mau so 01/TB-DKDT,
Mau so 01/TB-SSDT, Mau so 01/TB-KTDL, Mau so 01/TB-KTT tai Phu luc IB,
Mau so 03/TNCN tai Phu luc III ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay.
3. Thay thé cum tur “ho, ca nhan kinh doanh" bang cum tu “ho kinh doanh,
ca nhan kinh doanh" tai Dieu 2, khoan 4 Dieu 4, Dieu 14, Dieu 17, Dieu 23,
Dieu 25, Dieu 27, Dieu 29 Nghi dinh so 123/2020/ND-CP.
4. Bai bo khoan 10 Dieu 3; diém g khoan 4 Dieu 9; khoan 2 Dieu 33; Dieu 37;
khoan 2 Dieu 50; Dieu 51; khoan 3, khoan 4 Dieu 52; khoan 5 Dieu 53.
Dieu 3. Hieu lurc va trach nhiem thi hanh
1. Nghi dinh nay co hieu luc thi hanh tur ngay 01 thang 6 nam 2025.
2. Bo trurong Bo Tai chinh huong dan thi hanh cac khoan 3, khoan 6, khoan 7,
khoan 11, khoan 18, khoan 37 va khoan 38 Dieu 1 Nghi dinh nay va cac trurong
hop khac theo yeu cau quan ly.
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luat

3. Cac Bo trurong, Thu truong co quan ngang bo, Thu truong co quan thuoc
Chinh phu, Chu tich Uy ban nhan dan tinh, thanh pho trurc thuoc trung uong va
cac to churc, ca nhan co lien quan chiu trach nhiem thi hanh Nghi dinh nay./.
Noinhan
TM. CHiNH PHU
- Ban Bi thu Trung uong Dang,
KT. THU TUONG
- Thi turong, cac Pho Thi turong Chinh phu;
- Cac bo, co quan ngang bo, co quan thuoc Chinh phu;
- HDND, UBND cac tinh, thanh pho trurc thuoc trung y
- Van phong Trung uong va cac Ban cia Dang;
- Van phong Tong Bi thur;
- Van phong Chu tich nuoc;
- Hoi dong Dan toc va cac Uy ban cua Quoc hoi;
- Van phong Quoc hoi;
- Toa an nhan dan toi cao;
- Vien kiem sat nhan dan toi cao;
DircPhoc
-Kiem toan nha nuoc;
- Ngan hang Chinh sach xa hoi;
- Ngan hang Phat trien Viet Nam;
- Uy ban trung urong Mat tran To quoe Viet Nam;
- Co quan trung urong cia cac doan the;
-VPCP: BTCN, cac PCN, Tro ly TTg, TGD Cong TTDT,
cac Vu, Cuc, don vi trurc thuoc, Cong bao;
- Lu: VT, KTTH (2b)00
LuatVietnam
Tien ich van ban luat

title: Nghị định 254/2026/NĐ-CP Quy định chi tiết Luật Quản lý thuế số 108/2025/QH15 về hóa đơn, chứng từ điện tử
summary: Quy định chi tiết thi hành Luật Quản lý thuế 108/2025/QH15; các trường hợp sử dụng HĐĐT có mã và không có mã, hóa đơn khởi tạo từ máy tính tiền; chia sẻ kết nối dữ liệu; chính sách thưởng cho người tiêu dùng tố giác vi phạm hóa đơn.
content:
CHINH PHU
CONG HOA XA HOI CHU NGHIA VIET NAM
Doc lap-Tu do-Hanh phic
S6:254/2026/ND-CP
Ha Noi, ngiy 30 thang 6 nam 2026
NGHIDINH
Quy dinh chi tiet mot so dieu va bien phap de to chtc,
hurong dan thihanhLuatQuan ly thue so108/2025/QH15
ve hoa don dien tir, chirng tir dien tir
Can cie Luat T6 chirc Chinh phu so63/2025/QH15;
Can cur Luat Quan ly thue so108/2025/QH15;
Theo de nghi cua Bo truong Bo Tai chinh;
Chinh phui ban hanh Nghi dinh quy dinh chi tiet mot so dieu va bien phap
ae to chitc, hurong dan thi hanh Luat Quan ly thue so 108/2025/QH15 ve hoa
don dien ti, chirng tir dien tit.
ChurongI
QUYDINHCHUNG
Dieu 1.Pham vi dieu chinh
1. Quy dinh chi tiét khoan 6 Dieu 26, khoan 4 Dieu 27 Luat Quan ly thue
so108/2025/QH15baogom:
a) Loai hoa don dien tir, doi turong sur dung, noi dung, thoi diem lap hoa
don dien tir, trurong hop khong phai sir dung hoa don dien ti'r, truong hop str
dung hoa don dien tur duoc mien phi dich vu; nhiem vu,quyen han, trach nhiem
cua to chtrc, ca nhan trong viec quan ly, sir dung hoa don dien tir,
b) Loai chirng tir dien tir; noi dung, thoi diem lap chung tir dien tr, phurong
thurc lap chimg tir dien tir, van ban hanh chinh thue dien tur; ket noi, truyen dtr
lieu chung tir dien tir, truong hop sur dung duroc mien phi dich vu; nhiem vu,
quyen han, trach nhiem cua to churc,ca nhan trong viecquan ly,sur dung chung
tir dien tir.
2. Quy dinh cac noi dung khac theo churc nang, nhiem vu dam bao yeu cau
quanly theoquydinh tai khoan5Dieu52Luat Quan ly thue so108/2025/QH15
bao gom:

a) Nguyen tac lap, quan ly, sir dung hoa don dien tr, ching tur dien tir, bao
quan, luru trtr hoa don, chirng tur va chuyen doi hoa don dien ttr, chung tu dien
tir,
b) Lap hoa don dien tir co ma cua co quan thue; lap hoa don dien ti khong
co ma cua co quan thue; xir ly suy co; uy nhiem lap bien lai;
c) Xay dung thong tin hoa don dien tir, chirng tir dien tt gom: nguyen tac
chung, xay dung ha tang ky thuat cong nghe thong tin; he thong phan mem
phuc vu quan ly,van hanh, khai thac he thong thong tin hoa don dien tur, chirng
tir dien tir; xay dung, thu thap, xir ly va quan ly he thong thong tin ve hoa don
dien tur, chung tur dien tir,
d) Tra ciru, cung cap, str dung thong tin hoa don dien tur gom: nguyen tac
tra ciru, cung cap, sur dung thong tin hoa don dien tir, tra ctru thong tin hoa don
dien ti phuc vu kiem tra hang hoa luu thong tren thi trurong; doi turong cung
cap thong tin, sur dung thong tin hoa don dien tir, hinh thirc khai thac, su dung
thong tin hoa don dien tir tren He thong thong tin quan ly thue;
d) Trach nhiem cua co quan thue; trach nhiem cia ben str dung thong tin;
trach nhiem chia se, ket noi thong tin, ditr lieu hoa don dien tur, khen thurong
nguroi tieu dung to giac nguroi ban khong lap va giao hoa don dien tur va kinh
phi thurc hien.
Dieu 2. Doi turong ap dung
1. To churc, ca nhan ban hang hoa, cung cap djch vu (sau day goi la nguroi
ban) bao gom:
a) Doanh nghiep, hop tac xa, lien hiep hop tac xa duoc thanh lap va hoat
dong theo phap luat Viet Nam; chi nhanh, van phong dai dien cua doanh nghiep
nuoc ngoai hoat dong tai Viet Nam (sau day goi la to chtrc kinh te);
b) Ho kinh doanh, ca nhan kinh doanh, to hop tac;
c) Don vi su nghiep cong lap co ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu;
d) To churc khong phai la doanh nghiep nhung co hoat dong kinh doanh;
d) To chirc nuroc ngoai (bao gom ca chi quan nen tang thuong mai dien
tir, nen tang so  nuoc ngoai) co hoat dong kinh doanh tren nen tang thurong
mai dien tir va cac djch vu khac co phat sinh doanh thu tinh thue tai Viet Nam
(sau day goi la nha cung cap nuroc ngoai) dang ky tur nguyen sir dung hoa don
dien tur theo quy dinh tai Nghi dinh nay.
2. To chirc, ca nhan mua hang hoa, dich vu.

3. To chirc thu thue, phi va le phi.
4.Nguroinopthue,phivalephi.
5. To churc, ca nhan co trach nhiem khau trir thue theo quy dinh cua phap
luat thue;to churc,ca nhankhai thay,nop thue thay theo quy dinh cua phap luat
ve thue va phap luat ve quan ly thue.
6. To chirc cung cap dich vu hoa don dien tu, chirng tur dien tir.
7. Co quan quan ly thue.
8. Cac to chtrc, ca nhan co lien quan den viec quan ly, sir dung hoa don va
chingtir.
Dieu 3. Giai thich tur ngir
Trong Nghi dinh nay, cac tir ngir duoi day dugc hieu nhu sau:
1. Hoa don dien tur co ma cua co quan thue la hoa don dien tu durgc co
quan thue cap ma truroc khi nguoi ban guri cho nguoi mua.
Ma cua co quan thue tren hoa don dien tur bao gom so giao dich la mot day
so duy nhat do he thong cua co quan thue tao ra va mot chuoi ky tur durgc co
quan thue ma hoa dura tren thong tin cua nguroi ban lap tren hoa don dien tir.
2. Hoa don dien tr khong co ma cua co quan thue la hoa don dien tur do to
chtrc ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu giri cho nguroi mua khong co ma cua co
quan thue.
3. Hoa don dien tur khoi tao tu may tinh tien co ket noi du lieu dien tur voi
co quan thue (sau day goi la hoa don dien tur tir may tinh tien) la hoa don dien
tir co ma cia co quan thue hoac hoa don dien tur khong co ma cua co quan thue
hoac du lieu dien tur de nguroi mua co the truy xuat, ke khai thong tin hoa don
dien tur khoi tao tir may tinh tien do to churc, ca nhan ban hang hoa, cung cap
dich vu lap tir he thong tinh tien, du lieu dugc chuyen den co quan thue theo
dinh dang chuan du lieu.
4. May tinh tien la he thong tinh tien bao gom mot thiet bi dien tu dong bo
hogc mot he thong gom nhieu thiet bi dien tur duroc ket hop voi nhau bang giai
phap cong nghe thong tin co churc nang chung nhur: tinh tien, luru trur cac giao
dich ban hang, so lieu ban hang.
5. Hoa don, ching tur hop phap la hoa don, chtrng tur dam bao dung ve
hinh thurc va noi dung theo quy dinh tai Nghi dinh nay.

6.Hoa don, chirng tur gia la hoa don, ching tur durgc in hoackhoi tao theo
mau hoa don, ching tir da dugc thong bao phat hanh cua to churc, ca nhan khac
hoac in, khoi tao trung so cua cung mot ky hieu mau so hoa don, ky hieu hoa
don, ching tir hoac lam gia hoa don dien tur, chung tir dien tur.
7. Sir dung hoa don, chung tur khong hop phap la viec sur dung hoa don,
chirng tir gia, sir dung hoa don, ching tir chua co gia tri su dung, het gia tri sur
dung; sir dung hoa don bi nging su dung trong thoi gian bi curong che bang
bien phap ngiung sur dung hoa don, trir trurong hop duroc phep su dung theo
thong bao cua co quan thue; sir dung hoa don dien tir khong dang ky sur dung
voi co quan thue, sir dung hoa don dien tur chura co ma cua co quan thue doi voi
trurong hop sir dung hoa don dien tur co ma cua co quan thue; sir dung hoa don
mua hang hoa, djch vu co ngay lap tren hoa don tur ngay co quan thue xac dinh
ben ban khong hoat dong tai dja chi kinh doanh da dang ky voi co quan nha
nuoc co tham quyen; sir dung hoa don, ching tur mua hang hoa, djch vu co ngay
lap tren hoa don,ching tur truoc ngay xac dinh ben lap hoa don, chirng tirkhong
hoat dong tai dia chi kinh doanh da dang ky voi co quan nha nuoc co tham
quyen hoac chura co thong bao cia co quan thue ve viec ben lap hoa don, ching
tur khong hoat dong tai dia chi kinh doanh da dang ky voi co quan co tham
quyen nhung co quan thue hoac co quan cong an hoac cac co quan chtrc nang
khac da co ket luan do la hoa don, chirng tur khong hop phap.
Sir dung khong hop phap hoa don, chung tur la viec str dung hoa don,
churng tur tay xoa, sura chira khong dung quy dinh; str dung hoa don, chirng tir
khong (hoa don, chung tir da ghi cac chi tieu, noi dung nghiep vu kinh te nhung
viec mua ban hang hoa, dich vu khong co that mot phan hoac toan bo); sur dung
hoa don phan anh khong dung gia tri thuc te phat sinh hoac lap hoa don khong,
lap hoa don gia; sir dung hoa don co su chenh lech ve gia tri hang hoa, djch vu
hoac sai lech cac tieu thurc bat buoc giura cac lien cua hoa don (doivoi hoa don
giay da phat hanh, str dung trong giai doan truoc khi chuyen sang hoa don dien
tir);, str dung hoa don de quay vong khi van chuyen hang hoa trong khau luru
thong hoac dung hoa don cia hang hoa, dich vu nay de chimg minh cho hang
hoa, dich vu khac; sur dung hoa don, chumg tur cua to churc, ca nhan khac (trir

b) Thong bao cac loai chimg tur da duoc phat hanh, duoc bao mat, khong
con gia tri sur dung.
2. Chi cuc Hai quan khu vurc co trach nhiem:
a) Quan ly hoat dong tao, phat hanh ching tur cua cac to churc da dang ky
tao, phat hanh chung tir voi co quan hai quan tren dia ban quan ly;
b) Kiem tra hoat dong tao, phat hanh va sir dung chung tur tren dja ban;
c) Theo doi, kiem tra hoat dong huy ching tur theo quy dinh cua Bo Tai
chinhtrendja ban.
Churo'ng IV
XAY DUNG, TRA CUU THONG TIN HOA DON DIEN TU,
CHUNGTUDIENTU
Muc1
XAY DUNG THONG TIN HOA DON DIEN TU, CHUNG TU DIEN TU
Dieu 31.Nguyen tac chung
L. He thong thong tin ve hoa don, chimg tur phai durgc xay dung va quan
ly thong nhat tir trung uong den dja phurong; tuan thu cac tieu chuan, quy chuan

ky thuat ve cong nghe thong tin.
2. Co so du lieu hoa don, chtng tur phai bao dam phuc vu kip thoi cho
cong tac quan ly thue, quan ly khac cua nha nuoc; dap irng yeu cau phat trien
kinh te - xa hoi; bao dam tinh an toan, bao mat va an ninh quoc gia.
3. Cac thong tin, dur lieu ve hoa don, chtrng tir durgc thu thap, cap nhat,
duy tri, dam bao tinh chinh xac, trung thurc va khach quan.
4. Viec xay dung, quan ly,khai thac sur dung, cap nhat co so du lieu ve
hoa don, chung tur phai dam bao tinh chinh xac, khoa hoc, khach quan, kip thoi.
5. Co so dir lieu hoa don, chtng tur duroc xay dung va két noi, chia se tren
moi truong dien tr phuc vu quan ly,khai thac, cung cap, sir dung thong tin, dtr
lieu thuan tien, hieu qua.
6. Viec khai thac, str dung thong tin, du lieu hoa don, churng tir phai dam
bao dung muc dich, tuan theo cac quy dinh cua phap luat.
7. Co so du lieu ve hoa don, ching tir dugc ket noi, trao doi voi he thong
thong tin, co so du lieu ciua cac bo, nganh, dja phuong co lien quan.
Dieu 32. Xay dung ha tang ky thuat cong nghe thong tin, he thong
phan mem phuc vu quan ly, van hanh, khai thac he thong thong tin hoa
don dien tu, chirng tir dien tur
1. Ha tang ky thuat cong nghe thong tin hoa don dien tir, ching tir dien tur
bao gom tap hop thiet bi tinh toan (may chil, may tram), he thong durong truyen,
thiet bj ket noi mang, thiet bi (hoac phan mem) an ninh an toan mang va co so
du lieu, thiet bj luru trtr, thiet bi ngoai vi va thiet bi phu tro, mang noi bo.
2. He thong phan mem de quan ly, van hanh, khai thac he thong thong tin
hoa don dien tir, chirng tir dien tur gom: he dieu hanh, he quan tri co so du lieu
va phan mem i'ng dung.
Dieu 33. Xay dung, thu thap, xir ly va quan ly he thong thong tin ve
hoadon dien tir, chirng tir dien tir
1. Xay dung he thong thong tin ve hoa don, ching tir
a) Co so dur lieu hoa don, chung tur la tap hop cac dur lieu thong tin hoa
don, ching tir durgc sap xep, to chtrc de truy cap, khai thac, quan ly va cap nhat
thong qua phuong tien dien tur;
b) Co so dur lieu hoa don, chumg tur do co quan thue quan ly durgc Cuc
Thue, Kho bac Nha nuroc phoi hop voi cac don vi co lien quan xay dung phu
hop voi khung kien truc Chinh phu dien tir Viet Nam va bao gom cac thanh
phan noi dung: dang ky sur dung thong tin; thong bao huy hoa don, chirng tir,
thong tin ve hoa don dien tur nguoi ban co trach nhiem guri cho co quan thue,

thong tin ve churng tiur guri co quan thue; thong tin khai thue lien quan den hoa
don, chung tir.
2. Thu thap, cap nhat thong tin ve hoa don, chtng tur
Thong tin ve hoa don, ching tur duroc thu thap dura tren cac thong tin ma
nguroi ban,nguroi sir dung co trach nhiem gui cho co quan thue, thong tin tur cac
co quan khac gui den co lien quan den hoa don dien tir, chimg tur dien tur, thong
tin thu duoc tir cong tac quan ly thue cua co quan thue.
3. Xir ly thong tin ve hoa don, chung tur
Cuc Thue co trach nhiem xur ly thong tin, du lieu truroc khi durgc tich hop
va luru trir vao co so dtr lieu quoc gia de dam bao tinh hop ly, thong nhat. Noi
dung xur ly thong tin, dur lieu gom:
a) Kiem tra, danh gia viec tuan thu quy dinh, quy trinh trong viec thu thap
thong tin, du lieu;
b) Kiem tra, danh gia ve co so phap ly,mtrc do tin cay ciua thong tin, du lieu,
c) Tong hop, sap xep, phan loai thong tin, dt lieu phu hop voi noi dung
quy dinh;
d) Doi voi cac thong tin, du lieu duroc cap nhat tir co so du lieu chuyen
nganh thi co quan quan ly co so dir lieu chuyen nganh do co trach nhiem dam
bao ve tinh chinh xac cua thong tin, du lieu.
4. Quan ly he thong thong tin ve hoa don, chung tr
Cuc Thue co trach nhiem quan ly he thong thong tin ve hoa don, chtng tur
theo quy dinh sau:
a) Xay durng, quan ly, van hanh va khai thac he thong thong tin hoa don,
churng tur va thurc hien dich vu cong ve hoa don dien tur, chirng tur dien ttr neu
can thiet;
b) Tich hop ket qua dieu tra va cac du lieu, thong tin co lien quan den hoa
don, chimng tir do cac bo, nganh, co quan co lien quan cung cap,
c) Huong dan, kiem tra, giam sat viec quan ly va khai thac he thong thong
tin hoa don, ching tir tai co quan thue dja phuong,
d) Xay dung va ban hanh quy dinh ve phan quyen truy cap vao he thong
thong tin hoa don, chung tir; quan ly viec ket noi, chia se va cung cap du lieu
voi co so ditr lieu cua cac bo, nganh, co quan trung uong va dja phurong;
d) Chi tri, phoi hop voi cac don vi co lien quan xay dung cac phan mem
trong he thong thong tin hoa don, chirng tir.

Muc 2
TRA CUU, CUNG CAP, SU DUNG THONG TIN HOA DON DIEN TU
Dieu 34. Nguyen tac tra ctru, cung cap, si dung thong tin hoa do'n dien
1. Viec tra ctru, cung cap, str dung thong tin hoa don dien tu duroc ap dung
de thuc hien cac thu tuc ve thue, thu tuc thanh toan qua ngan hang va cac thi
tuc hanh chinh khac; chung minh tinh hop phap cua hang hoa luru thong tren
thitrurong.
2. Viec tra ctru, cung cap thong tin hoa don dien tur phai dam bao day di,
chinh xac, kip thoi va ding doi tuong.
3. Viec sur dung thong tin hoa don dien tur durgc cung cap phai dam bao
duing muc dich, phuc vu cho hoat dong nghiep vu theo churc nang, nhiem vu
ciua ben sir dung thong tin; dong thoi phai dam bao dung quy dinh cua phap luat
ve bao vebimat nha nuoc.
Dieu 35. Tra ciru thong tin hoa don dien tir phuc vu kiem tra hang
hoa luru thong tren thi truong
1. Khi kiem tra hang hoa luu thong tren thi truong, doi voi truong hop str
dung hoa don dien tur, co quan nha nuoc, nguroi co tham quyen truy cap He
thong thong tin quan ly thue de tra ciru thong tin ve hoa don dien tir phuc vu
yeu cau quan ly, khong yeu cau cung cap hoa don giay. Cac co quan co lien
quan co trach nhiem str dung cac thiet bi de truy cap tra ciru dtr lieu hoa don
dien tur.
2. Trurong hop bat kha khang do sur co, thien tai gay anh huong den viec
truy cap mang Internet dan den khong tra ciru duoc dt lieu hoa don thi co quan
nha nuoc, nguoi co tham quyen dang thurc hien kiem tra thuc hien cac bien
phap phu hop de tra curu thong tin hoa don dien tur.
Dieu 36.Doi tuong cung cap thong tin, sir dung thong tin hoa don dien
tur
1. Cuc Thue la don vi cung cap thong tin hoa don dien tur doi voi de nghi
cua cac co quan, to chirc quan ly nha nuoc cap Trung uong. Thue tinh, thanh
pho, Thue co so cung cap thong tin doi voi de nghi cia co quan, to churc quan
ly dong cap.
2. Cac ben sir dung thong tin hoa don dien tir bao gom:

a) Cac to churc kinh te, to churc khac, ho kinh doanh, ca nhan kinh doanh
la nguroi ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu, ben nhan iy nhiem lap hoa don, cac
to chirc, ca nhan la nguoi mua hang hoa, dich.vu;
b) Cac co quan quan ly nha nuroc sur dung thong tin hoa don dien tir de
thurc hien cac thu tuc hanh chinh theo quy dinh ciua phap luat; kiem tra tinh hop
phap cua hang hoa luu thong tren thi trurong, phuc vu hoat dong to tung, thanh
tra, kiem tra, kiem toan;
c) Cac to churc tin dung su dung thong tin hoa don dien tur de thuc hien cac
thu tuc ve thue, thu tuc thanh toan qua ngan hang;
d) Cac to chtrc cung cap dich vu hoa don dien tir,
d) Cac to churc sur dung thong tin chtrng tir dien tir khau trir thue thu nhap
canhan;
e) Co quan quan ly thue nuroc ngoai phu hop voi dieu uroc quoc te ve thue
ma nuoc Cong hoa xa hoi chi nghia Viet Nam la thanh vien;
g) Cac to chtrc dugc uy quyen cua to chtrc kinh té, ho kinh doanh, ca nhan
kinh doanh la nguoi ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu theo quy dinh cua phap
luatdan sur.
Dieu 37. Hinh thtrc khai thac, sir dung thong tin hoa don dien tir tren
Hethong thong tin quan lythue
1. Ben str dung thong tin la cac to chtrc kinh te, ho kinh doanh, ca nhan
kinh doanh la nguoi ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu, ben nhan uy nhiem lap
hoa don; cac to churc, ca nhan la nguoi mua hang hoa, dich vu khai thac thong
tin tur hoa don dien tir theo cac noi dung thong tin tur He thong thong tin quan
ly thue.
2. Ben sir dung thong tin la cac co quan quan ly nha nuroc, cac to churc tin
dung, to chirc cung cap djch vu hoa don dien tir, cac to chuc duroc iy quyen cua
to churc kinh te, ho kinh doanh, ca nhan kinh doanh la nguoi ban hang hoa, cung
cap djch vu theo quy dinh cua phap luat dan sur: tra ciru, sir dung thong tin hoa
don dien tur, chung tur dien tur theo pham vi, thoi gian, trach nhiem va quyen
truy cap He thong thong tin quan ly thue durgc guy dinh cu the tai van ban thong
nhat giura hai ben hoac theo hinh thurc cung cap dich vu truy van truc tiep voi
He thong thong tin quan ly thue.
Ben str dung thong tin co trach nhiem phan cong dau moi dang ky sir dung
thong tin hoa don dien tir (sau day goi tat la dau moi dang ky) va thong bao cho
Cuc Thue bang van ban hoac van ban dien tur. Trurong hop siur dung thong tin
theo hinh thirc cung cap dich vu truy van trurc tiep voi He thong thong tin quan
ly thue phai dam bao cac tieu chi nhur doi voi to chirc cung cap dich vu nhan,
truyen, luru tritr dir lieu hoa don dien tir.

3. Cuc Thue, Thue tinh, thanh pho thurc hien cap toi da 02 tai khoan khai
thac str dung thong tin hoa don dien tur cho nguoi str dung cua co quan, to churc
quan ly dong cap theo van ban gitra cac ben.
4.Bo trurong Bo Tai chinh huong dan viec cung cap, tra ctru thong tin hoa
don dien tir, dangky moi, bo sung thong tin dangky,thu hoi taikhoan truy cap
He thong thong tin quan ly thue; cham dit s'r dung cac hinh thurc cung cap, str
dung thong tin hoa don dien tir.
Dieu 38.Trach nhiem cia co quan thue
1. Xay dung, trien khai, quan ly van hanh He thong thong tin quan ly thue
cu the:
a) Bao dam cho to chtrc, ca nhan truy cap thuan tien; co cong cu tim kiem
thong tin, dtr lieu de sir dung va cho ket qua dung noi dung can tim kiem;
b) Bao dam khuon dang thong tin, du lieu theo tieu chuan, quy chuan ky
thuat, quy dinh de de dang tai xuong, hien thi nhanh chong va in an bang cac
phurong tien dien tir pho bien;
c) Dam bao he thong hoat dong lien tuc, on dinh, dam bao an toan thong
tin;
d) Chu tri thurc hien viec hurong dan sur dung, ho trg van hanh he thong.
2. Quan ly viec dang ky str dung thong tin hoa don dien tur, chung tur dien
tir cia ben sir dung thong tin.
3. Truong hop tam ngung cung cap thong tin hoa don dien tiu, chung tir
dien tir, Cuc Thue thuc hien thong bao tren Trang thong tin dien tur cua Cuc
Thue ve hoa don dien tir voi cac ben sir dung thong tin. Noi dung thong bao
phai neu ro khoang thoi gian du kien phuc hoi cac hoat dong cung cap thong
tin.
Dieu 39. Trach nhiem ciua ben sir dung thong tin
1. Sur dung thong tin hoa don dien tur dung muc dich, phuc vu cho hoat
dong nghiep vu theo chirc nang, nhiem vu cia ben sir dung thong tin, dung quy
dinh cua phap luat ve bao ve bi mat nha nuroc. Cac thong tin thu thap tir co quan
thue, ben str dung thong tin khong cung cap thong tin cho ben thur ba khi chura
co su dong y cua co quan thue cung cap thong tin hoac tai khoan.
2. Trang bi day du phurong tien, trang thiet bi ky thuat de bao dam thurc
hien viec tra ctru, ket noi, sir dung thong tin hoa don dien tur.
3. Thurc hien dang ky de durgc cap quyen truy cap, khai thac, su dung thong
tin hoa don dien tu.

4. Quan ly, bao mat thong tin tai khoan truy cap He thong thong tin quan
ly thue.
Dieu 4o. Trach nhiem chia se, ket noi thong tin, dir lieu hoa don dien
tir
1. Cac to chuc kinh te san xuat, kinh doanh  cac linh vuc: dien lurc; xang
dau; buu chinh, vien thong; van tai hang khong, durong bo, durong sat, durong
bien, durong thuy; nuoc sach; tai chinh ngan hang; bao hiem; y te; kinh doanh
thuong mai dien tur, kinh doanh sieu thi; thuong mai thurc hien hoa don dien ttr
va cung cap dur lieu hoa don dien tur theo dinh dang chuan du lieu.
2. Cac to churc tin dung, to churc cung tng dich vu thanh toan cung cap dur
lieu dien tu ve giao dich thanh toan qua tai khoan cua cac to chrc, ca nhan khi
co yeu cau bang van ban cua co quan thue viec cung cap thong tin khach hang
thurc hien theo quy djnh cua phap luat ve ngan hang.
3. To chiurc, ca nhan san xuat, nhap khau nhing san pham chiu thue tieu
quet ma QR cho san pham san xuat tai Viet Nam truoc khi tieu thu trong nuoc
hoac san pham san xuat o nuoc ngoai khi nhap khau de dam bao ket noi thong
tin ve in va sur dung tem, tem dien tur gitra to chtrc san xuat, nhap khau voi co
quan quan ly thue. Thong tin ve in, str dung tem dien tur la co so de lap, quan ly
va xay dung co so dur lieu hoa don dien tir. Cac doi turong sir dung tem co trach
nhiem chi tra chi phi in va sur dung tem theo quy dinh cua Bo truong Bo Tai
chinh.
4. Cac to churc, don vi: Co quan quan ly thi trurong, Cuc Quan ly dat dai,
Cuc Dja chat va Khoang san Viet Nam, co quan cong an, giao thong, y te va
cac co quan khac co lien quan ket noi chia se thong tin, dur lieu lien quan can
thiet trong linh vuc quan ly cua don vi voi Cuc Thue de xay dung co so dur lieu
hoa don dien tur.
Dieu 41. Khen thurong nguoi tieu dung to giac nguroi ban khong lap
vagiaohoadondientir
1. Nguroi tieu dung to giac nguoi ban khong lap va giao hoa don dien tur
khi ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu durgc xem xet khen thurong khi dap ing cac
dieu kien sau:
a) Cung cap thong tin trung thuc, chinh xac, kip thoi; co can cur xac dinh
thoi gian, dja diem va nguoi thurc hien hanh vi vi pham;
b) Noi dung thong tin phan anh dung thurc te phat sinh, du co so de co
quan thue xac dinh tinh chat, murc do vi pham va thurc hien kiem tra, xac minh;

c) Tren co so thong tin phan anh, cung cap, co quan thue da ban hanh
quyet dinh xur phat vi pham hanh chinh ve thue, hoa don theo quy dinh cua phap
luat ve quan ly thue.
2. Thong tin to giac bao gom:
a) Thong tin ve nguroi ban hang hoa, cung cap djch vu (ten, dia chi hoac
ma so thue) va mot trong cac thong tin sau:
a.1) Thong tin ve giao dich hang hoa, dich vu,
a.2) Thong tin ve hanh vi khong lap hoa don va khong giao hoa don;
a.3) Tai lieu, churng cur co lien quan den giao dich phat sinh hanh vi vi
pham cua nguoi ban (neu co);
b) Thong tin lien he cua nguoi tieu dung to giac, gom: ten, so dien thoai,
so dinh danh ca nhan.
3. Nguoi tieu dung thurc hien to giac hanh vi khong lap va giao hoa don
dien tur cua nguoi ban thong qua mot trong cac hinh thurc sau:
a) Qua he thong hoa don dien tir hoac He thong thong tin quan ly thue
(nhureTax Mobile);
b) Qua Cong dich vu cong quoc gia;
c) Qua thur dien tur chinh thurc hoac he thong tiep nhan thong tin dien tur
cua co quan thue;
d) Guri trurc tiep tai tru so co quan thue hoac bang van ban theo quy dinh.
4. Nguyen tac xac dinh khen thurong
a) Viec khen thuong duroc thurc hien tren co so ket qua xac minh, xur ly
cua co quan thue va quyet dinh xi phat vi pham hanh chinh ve thue, hoa don
theo quy dinh cua phap luat ve quan ly thue;
b) Bao dam cong khai, minh bach, dung doi tuong, dong thoi bao mat
thong tin nguroi cung cap theo quy dinh;
c) Moi vu viec chi duroc xem xet khen thuong mot lan. Trurong hop co
nhieu nguroi cung cung cap thong tin ve mot hanh vi vi pham thi viec khen
thuong duroc xem xet doi voi nguroi cung cap thong tin dau tien hoac nguroi co
thong tin day du, co gia tri nhat theo xac nhan cua co quan thue.

title: Nghị định 15/2022/NĐ-CP Chính sách miễn, giảm thuế theo Nghị quyết 43/2022/QH15
summary: Quy định chính sách giảm thuế giá trị gia tăng từ 10% xuống 8%; danh mục hàng hóa dịch vụ không được giảm (Phụ lục I, II, III); chi phí được trừ khi xác định thu nhập chịu thuế TNDN cho các khoản tài trợ phòng chống dịch Covid-19.
content:
CHiNH PHU
CONG HOA XA HQI CHU NGHIA VIET NAM
Doclap-Tu do-Hanhphic
So:15/2022/ND-CP
Ha Noi, ngay 28 thdng 01 nam 2022
NGHIDINH
Quy dinh chinh sach mien, giam thue theo Nghi quyét so 43/2022/QH15
cia Quoc hoi ve chinh sach tai khoa, tien te ho trg Churo'ng trinh
phuc hoi va phat triéen kinh te - xa hoi
Can ci Luat To chirc Chinh phi ngay 19 thang 6 nam 2015; Luat sia doi,
bo sung mot so aieu cua Luat To chirc Chinh phi va Luat To chirc chinh quyen
dia phuong ngay 22 thdng 11 nam 2019;
Can cur Luat Thue gid tri gia tang ngay 03 thang 6 nam 2008; Ludt sia doi,
bo sung mot so dieu cua Luat Thue gid tri gia tang ngay 19 thang 6 nam 2013; Ludt
sia doi, bo sung mot so dieu cua Ludt Thue gid tri gia tang, Ludat Thue tieu thu
dac biet va Luat Quan ly thue ngay 06 thng 4 nam 2016;
Can cis Luat Thue thu nhap doanh nghiep ngay 03 thang 6 nam 2008;
Luat sia doi, bo sung mot so aieu cua Luat Thue thu nhap doanh nghiep ngay 19
thdng 6 nam 2013;
Can cir Luat sira doi, bo sung mot so aieu cua cac Luat ve thue ngay 26 thdng 11
nam 2014;
Can cit Luat Qudn ly thue ngay 13 thdng 6 nam 2019;
Can ci: Nghi quyet so 43/2022/QH15 ngay 11 thang 01 nam 2022 cua
Quoc hoi ve chinh sach tai khoa, tien te ho tro Chuong trinh phuc hoi va phat
trién kinh té - xa hoi
Theo de nghi cua Bo truong Bo Tai chinh;
Chinh phi ban hanh Nghi dinh quy dinh chinh sach mien, giam thué theo
Nghi quyet so 43/2022/QH15 ngay 11 thang 01 nam 2022 cua Quoc hoi ve
chinh sach tai khoa, tien te ho trg Chuong trinh phuc hoi va phat trien kinh te
- xa hoi (sau day goi la Nghi quyet so 43/2022/QH15).
Dieu 1. Giam thué gia tri gia tang
1. Giam thue gia tri gia tang doi voi cac nhom hang hoa, dich vu dang ap
dung mtrc thue suat 10%, trur nhom hang hoa, dich vu sau:
a) Vien thong, hoat dong tai chinh, ngan hang, churng khoan, bao hiem,
kinh doanh bat dong san, kim loai va san pham tur kim loai duc san, san pham
khai khoang (khong ke khai thac than), than coc, dau mo tinh che, san pham
hoa chat. Chi tiét tai Phu luc I ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay.

b) San pham hang hoa va dich vu chiu thue tieu thu dac biet. Chi tiet tai
Phu luc II ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay.
c) Cong nghe thong tin theo phap luat ve cong nghe thong tin. Chi tiét tai
Phu luc III ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay.
d) Viec giam thué gia tri gia tang cho ting loai hang hoa, dich vu quy
dinh tai khoan 1 Dieu nay dugc ap dung thong nhat tai cac khau nhap khau,
san xuat, gia cong, kinh doanh thuong mai. Doi voi mat hang than khai thac
ban ra (bao gom ca trurong hop than khai thac sau do qua sang tuyen, phan
loai theo quy trinh khep kin moi ban ra) thuoc doi turong giam thue gia tri gia
tang. Mat hang than thuoc Phu luc I ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay, tai cac
khau khac ngoai khau khai thac ban ra khong duroc giam thue gia tri gia tang.
Trurong hop hang hoa, dich vu neu tai cac Phu luc I, II va III ban hanh
doi turong chiu thue gia tri gia tang 5% theo quy dinh cua Luat Thue gia tri gia
giam thué gia tri gia tang.
2. Murc giam thue gia tri gia tang
a) Co so kinh doanh tinh thue gia tri gia tang theo phurong phap khau triur
dugc ap dung murc thue suat thue gia tri gia tang 8% doi voi hang hoa, dich vu
quy dinh tai khoan 1 Dieu nay.
b) Co so kinh doanh (bao gom ca ho kinh doanh, ca nhan kinh doanh)
20% mtrc ty le % de tinh thue gia tri gia tang khi thuc hien xuat hoa don doi
voi hang hoa, dich vu dugc giam thue gia tri gia tang quy dinh tai khoan 1
Dieu nay.
3. Trinh tu, thu tuc thurc hien
a) Déi voi co so kinh doanh quy dinh tai diém a khoan 2 Dieu nay, khi
lap hoa don gia tri gia tang cung cap hang hoa, dich vu thuoc doi turong giam
thué gia tri gia tang, tai dong thué suat thue gia tri gia tang ghi "8%"; tien thue
gia tri gia tang; tong so tien nguoi mua phai thanh toan. Can cur hoa don gia
tri gia tang, co so kinh doanh ban hang hoa, dich vu ke khai thue gia tri gia
tang dau ra, co so kinh doanh mua hang hoa, dich vu ke khai khau trir thue gia
tri gia tang dau vao theo so thue da giam ghi tren hoa don gia tri gia tang.
b) Doi voi co so kinh doanh quy dinh tai diém b khoan 2 Dieu nay, khi
lap hoa don ban hang cung cap hang hoa, dich vu thuoc doi turong giam thué
gia tri gia tang, tai cot “Thanh tien"' ghi day du tien hang hoa, dich vu truroc
khi giam, tai dong “Cong tien hang hoa, dich vu" ghi theo so da giam 20%
murc ty le % tren doanh thu, dong thoi ghi chu: “da giam... (so tien) turong

ung 20% murc ty le % de tinh thué gia tri gia tang theo Nghi quyet so
43/2022/QH15".
4. Co so kinh doanh phai lap hoa don rieng cho hang hoa, dich vu duoc
giam thué gia tri gia tang. Trurong hop co so kinh doanh khong lap hoa don
rieng cho hang hoa, dich vu dugc giam thué gia tri gia tang thi khong duroc
giam thue gia tri gia tang.
5. Trurong hop co so kinh doanh da lap hoa don va da ke khai theo murc
co thoa thuan bang van ban ghi ro sai sot, dong thoi nguoi ban lap hoa don
dieu chinh sai sot va giao hoa don dieu chinh cho nguoi mua. Can cur vao hoa
don dieu chinh, nguoi ban ke khai dieu chinh thue dau ra, nguoi mua ke khai
diéu chinh thué dau vao (néu co).
6. Trurong hop co so kinh doanh hang hoa, dich vu thuoc doi turong dugc
giam thue gia tri gia tang da phat hanh hoa don dat in duroi hinh thurc ve co in
san menh gia chua sir dung het (neu co) va co nhu cau tiép tuc sir dung thi co
so kinh doanh thurc hien dong dau theo gia da giam 2% thue suat thue gia tri
gia tang hoac gia da giam 20% mtrc ty le % ben canh tieu thurc gia in san de
tiép tuc sir dung.
7. Co so kinh doanh quy dinh tai Dieu nay thuc hien ke khai cac hang
hoa, dich vu duoc giam thue gia tri gia tang theo Mau so 01 tai Phu luc IV
ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh nay cung voi To khai thue gia tri gia tang.
Dieu 2. Chi phi durgc trir khi xac dinh thu nhap chju thue thu nhap
doanh nghiep
1. Doanh nghiep, to churc la nguoi nop thue thu nhap doanh nghiep theo
triu khi xac dinh thu nhap chiu thue thu nhap doanh nghiep cua ky tinh thue
thu nhap doanh nghiep nam 2022 doi voi khoan chi ung ho, tai tro bang tien,
qua cac don vi nhan ing ho, tai trg quy dinh tai khoan 2 Dieu nay.
Trurong hop cong ty me nhan khoan ing ho, tai trg cua cac don vi thanh
vien de tap trung dau moi thuc hien hoat dong ung ho, tai tro thi cong ty me
va cac don vi thanh vien dugc tinh vao chi phi dugc trur khi xac dinh thu nhap
chiu thué thu nhap doanh nghiep turong urng voi khoan ing ho, tai tro cua
cong ty me va turng don vi thanh vien. Cong ty me phai co Bien ban hoac van
ban, tai lieu xac nhan khoan chi ing ho, tai trg neu tai khoan 4 Dieu nay. Don
vi thanh vien phai co hoa don, chung tur hop phap theo quy dinh cua phap luat
va co van ban xac nhan cua cong ty me ve khoan ung ho, tai tro cua ting don vi
thanh vien.

2. Don vi nhan ing ho, tai trg bao gom: Uy ban Mat tran To quoc Viet
Nam cac cap; co so y té; don vi luc luong vi trang; don vi, to churc duoc co
quan nha nuoc co tham quyen giao nhiem vu lam co so cach ly tap trung; co
phu; to churc dang, doan thanh nien, cong doan, hoi lien hiep phu nt Viet
Nam cac cap o trung uong va dia phuong; co quan, don vi chinh quyen dja
phuong cac cap co churc nang huy dong tai tro; Quy phong, chong dich
Covid-19 cac cap; Quy vac-xin phong Covid-19; Cong thong tin dien tir nhan
dao quoc gia; quy tur thien, nhan dao va to churc co churc nang huy dong tai tro
duroc thanh lap, hoat dong theo quy dinh cua phap luat.
Cac don vi nhan ung ho, tai trg co trach nhiem sur dung, phan phoi dung
muc dich cua khoan ing ho, tai trg cho cac hoat dong phong, chong dich Covid-
19 da tiep nhan. Trurong hop don vi nhan ing ho, tai trg sir dung sai muc dich
3. Uy ban-nhan dan cac tinh, thanh pho truc thuoc trung uong chi dao
cac co quan lien quan tai dia phurong tang curong phoi hop, trao doi, cung cap
thong tin cho co quan thue, co quan hai quan de quan ly chat che, xir ly
nghiem hanh vi nang gia tri, khai gia tri bat hop ly trong hoat dong ung ho, tai
trg; phoi hop quan ly chat che gia mua ban hang hoa, dich vu, hoa don cung
cap hang hoa, dich vu va xir ly cac trurong hop gia mua ban tren hop dong, gia
tren hoa don cung cap hang hoa, dich vu khong dung voi thuc té theo quy
dinh cua phap luat.
4. Ho so xac dinh khoan chi ung ho, tai trg gom co: Bien ban xac nhan
ung ho, tai trg theo Mau so 02 tai Phu luc IV ban hanh kem theo Nghi dinh
nay hoac van ban, tai lieu (hinh thurc giay hoac dien tur) xac nhan khoan chi
ung ho, tai trg co chur ky, dong dau cua nguoi dai dien doanh nghiep, to churc
la don vi ung ho, tai trg va dai dien cua don vi nhan ing ho, tai tro; kem theo
hoa don, chung tir hop phap theo quy dinh cua phap luat cua khoan ung ho, tai
trg bang tién hoac hien vat.
Dieu 3. Hieu lurc thi hanh va to chirc thuc hien
1. Nghi dinh nay co hieu lurc tir ngay 01 thang 02 nam 2022.
Dieu 1 Nghi dinh nay dugc ap dung ké tur ngay 01 thang 02 nam 2022
dén hét ngay 31 thang 12 nam 2022.
Dieu 2 Nghi dinh nay ap dung cho ky tinh thue thu nhap doanh nghiep nam
2022.
2. Cac bo theo churc nang, nhiem vu va Uy ban nhan dan tinh, thanh pho
truc thuoc trung uong chi dao cac co quan lien quan trién khai tuyen truyen,
huong dan, kiem tra, giam sat de nguoi tieu dung hiéu va duoc thu huong loi

do tap trung cac giai phap on dinh cung cau hang hoa, dich vu thuoc doi
turong giam thue gia tri gia tang nham git binh on mat bang gia ca thi trurong
(gia chua co thue gia tri gia tang) tur ngay 01 thang 02 nam 2022 den het ngay 31
thang 12 nam 2022 co ban on dinh so voi thoi diem truroc ngay 01 thang 02
nam 2022.
3. Trong qua trinh thurc hien neu phat sinh vuong mac giao Bo Tai chinh
huong dan, giai quyet.
4. Cac Bo truong, Thi truong co quan ngang bo, Thi trurong co quan
thuoc Chinh phi, Chu tich Uy ban nhan dan tinh, thanh pho trurc thuoc trung
uong va cac doanh nghiep, to chirc, ca nhan co lien quan chiu trach nhiem thi
hanh Nghi dinh nay.
Noi nhan:
TM. CHiNH PHU
- Ban Bi thu Trung uong Dang;
KT. THU TUONG
-Thu turong, cac Pho Thu turong Chinh phu;
- Cac bo, co quan ngang bo, co quan thuoc Chinh phu;
- HDND, UBND cac tinh, thanh pho trurc thuoc trung uon
- Van phong Trung uong va cac Ban cua Dang;
- Van phong Tong Bi thur;
- Van phong Chi tich nuoc;
- Hoi dong Dan toc va cac Uy ban cua Quoc hoi;
- Van phong Quoc hoi;
- Toa an nhan dan toi cao;
MinhKhai
- Vien kiem sat nhan dan toi cao;
- Kiem toan nha nuoc;
- Uy ban Giam sat tai chinh Quoc gia;
-Ngan hang Chinh sachxahoi;
- Ngan hang Phat trien Viet Nam;
- Uy ban trung uong Mat tran To quoc Viet Nam;
- Co quan trung uong cua cac doan thé;
- VPCP: BTCN, cac PCN, Trg ly TTg, TGD Cong TTDT,
cacVu,Cuc,donvitrurcthuoc,Congbao;
- Luu: VT, KTTH (2b)-A0

Dieu 2. Sira doi, bo sung khoan 4 Dieu 1 cia Nghi dinh so 15/2022/ND-CP

khi ban hang hoa, cung cap dich vu thi tren hoa don ban hang phai ghi ro so tien

Dieu 3. To chirc thurc hien va hieu lurc thi hanh

Truong hop tu ngay 01 thang 02 nam 2022 dén ngay Nghi dinh nay co hieu

nay thi van dugc giam thue gia tri gia tang va khong phai dieu chinh lai hoa don,
khong bi xur phat vi pham hanh chinh ve thue va hoa don.
